executable_decisions.decision: A01 architecture target is approved but no execution authorization; versioned history preserves no-code/no-WBS boundary
V1.1 findings are exploratory and historical; source candidate list contains six specific sources and four groups, and four ilaws paths share one domain
Unknown status is not proof of absence or permission; manual HTML access and robots do not establish legal reuse rights
Audit each source/path for authenticity, access, official API/MCP, license, SCM/SR/DDI, sample data and constraints; do not bypass controls, extract personal data, or crawl heavily
C01 requires S1-S5 and per-claim evidence; Unknown/Blocked sources cannot be bulk crawled or used in production; connector suggestion does not approve implementation
Work handoff includes audit, matrices, limited samples, open legal questions and staged gates; Work only has read-only/low-load/report authority; changes need separate owner approval

V1.2 supersedes V1.1 for current source decisions; owner public-source assumption does not equate to machine retrieval/full-text indexing/commercial republication permission; method rights are assessed separately
Public audit did not verify official API/MCP for six main sources; this is not proof none exist; robots is not a content rights decision
S1-S5 gates are per source and access method; actual production requires applicable S2/S3/S4/S5 despite allowing non-production design/prototyping

Proceed to Delivery Preparation/Design, not unconditional coding; ordered process includes approved release scope, PRD, technical design, limited non-production PoC, WBS, then owner code-approval gate; rights and design tracks run in parallel

All O5-01..14 are policy-approved but no execution gate thereby passed; O5-12 still needs canonical guide/repo reconciliation; first implementation PR requires deliverables and explicit owner approval

V1.4 moved FD-01..03, cancels incorrect ordering, and excludes them from first RAG release with timing open; V1.5 revenue model is draft and 500,000 toman example unapproved; V1.6 records current approval alignment without development/deployment authorization
